title: Concept: Atom created from input via list_to_atom (erlang) — review required
description: In erlang, list_to_atom creates atoms from runtime text. Atoms are never reclaimed, so unbounded input drives the VM past its atom limit and takes the node down. The remedy is list_to_existing_atom with a fixed allowlist.
applicability: erlang services converting external text to atoms; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Node crash and denial of service; MEDIUM severity.
